title: Evaluation of SC-V Versus Conventional CPR
brief_summary: To assess the benefits of a new method of cardiopulmonary resuscitation, SC-V CPR (simultaneous compression and ventilation CPR) in terms of short and long-term survival and lessened cerebral dysfunction.
raw_criteria: Men, women, and children in cardiac arrest for which CPR was initiated in ten minutes or less from the time of arrest.
